PartBuffer::PartBuffer ( Buffer const &  original,
long  startPoint = 0,
long  endPoint = 0,
long  fftSizeLog2 = 0 
) throw ()

Construct a partitioned buffer from a real (audio) buffer.

Parameters:
original The audio buffer to FTT and partition.
startPoint The sample number at which to start reading within the original.
endPoint The sample number at which to stop reading within the origina. If this is 0 all the remain samples in the original will be read.
fftSizeLog2 This will control the FFT size of the FFT operations on the partitioning. The FFT size will be if fftSizeLog2 is less than 4 then an FFT size of is used.
